title: Loop+ Membership Promotional Credit Rates and Limits
content:
Rate table for the promotional Loop+ credit a member earns: the No-Rush credit, the late-delivery credit, how long each stays valid, and the most credit earnable in a calendar month. Amounts are in US dollars.

## No-Rush credit and monthly cap

| Plan | Credit per No-Rush order (USD) | No-Rush credit valid for (calendar days after earning) | Most promotional credit earnable per calendar month (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | 1.00 | 30 | 10.00 |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | 1.00 | 30 | 10.00 |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 1.00 | 30 | 10.00 |
| Loop+ Monthly | 1.00 | 30 | 15.00 |
| Loop+ Annual | 1.00 | 30 | 15.00 |
| Loop+ Household Annual | 1.00 | 30 | 20.00 |

## Late-delivery credit

| Plan | Credit per late guaranteed member order (USD) | Most late-delivery credits per billing cycle | Delivery options whose late delivery earns the credit | Late-delivery credit valid for (calendar days after earning) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | 5.00 | 1 | Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day, Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 90 |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | 5.00 | 1 | Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day, Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 90 |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 5.00 | 3 | Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day, Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 90 |
| Loop+ Monthly | 5.00 | 1 | Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day, Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 90 |
| Loop+ Annual | 10.00 | 3 | Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day, Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 90 |
| Loop+ Household Annual | 10.00 | 4 | Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day, Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 90 |

## Definitions

- **No-Rush credit**: the promotional credit earned per order where the member chooses No-Rush delivery, in USD.
- **No-Rush credit validity**: the calendar days after earning that a No-Rush credit expires, a whole number.
- **Monthly earn cap**: the most promotional credit earnable per calendar month, in USD.
- **Late-delivery credit**: the credit earned when a guaranteed member order is delivered after its promised date, in USD.
- **Late-delivery credits per cycle**: the most late-delivery credits per billing cycle, a whole number of credits.
- **Late-credit delivery options**: the delivery options whose late delivery earns the credit, by official option name.
- **Late-delivery credit validity**: the calendar days after earning that a late-delivery credit expires, a whole number.

## Comparing plans

- Loop+ Annual and Loop+ Household Annual pay 10.00 per late-delivery credit; the other four plans pay 5.00.
- Loop+ Student Annual and Loop+ Annual both allow 3 late-delivery credits per billing cycle, but at different amounts (5.00 against 10.00).
- The No-Rush credit amount and both validity periods are the same on every plan; the monthly earn cap is 10.00, 15.00 or 20.00 depending on the plan.
